instruction: Candid realistic photograph, medium full shot. In a bright, white-walled ballet studio, the blonde ballerina (R2) in a white leotard and sheer skirt leans forward over a wooden barre on the left, smiling downward. Beside her on the right, the dark-haired ballerina (R1) in a matching white leotard and skirt stands upright, holding the barre behind her and looking left with a neutral expression. Soft, diffused daylight illuminates the scene.
elements: R2 is the ballerina leaning forward over the wooden barre
R1 is the ballerina standing upright and holding the barre behind her
R2 smiles downward while R1 looks left with a neutral expression
wooden ballet barre used as the contact object

questions.q: Is R2 the ballerina leaning forward over the wooden barre, rather than R1 being the one leaning forward over it?
questions.element: R2 has the asymmetric leaning-over-barre role

questions.q: Is R1 standing upright and holding the barre behind her, rather than R2 taking that upright holding-behind pose?
questions.element: R1 has the asymmetric upright barre-holding role

questions.q: Does R2 smile downward while leaning over the barre as R1 looks left with a neutral expression?
questions.element: R2 and R1 have distinct gaze and expression roles

questions.q: Is R1 positioned beside R2 while R1 remains upright and R2 bends forward over the barre?
questions.element: R1 upright beside R2 bending over the barre
